target_claim: Outside winning target reference equals next globally segmented running extremum in the accepted supervised displacement coordinate.
claim_scope: Partial winning-reference mechanism, conditional on decoder; not complete tail/copula, physical quote/time/source identification or public score.

episode_correction.old_approximately30: Weighted effective episode count, not raw changepoint count
episode_correction.effective_formula: (sum episode mass)^2/sum episode mass^2;mass=sum abs clipped TRAIN targets;no scoring mask

novelty: Global running-peak/trough reversal boundaries; threshold relative to evolving extremum, not origin. Test winning mark, not failed first-adverse/barrier/k-winner losing-offset law.
prior: Low; E162 first-move side/local4-event evidence favors local structure. Cheap deterministic counterexamples have higher value than a fit.

data.exclusions: All previous reconstruction/provided-decode/clock components and chain-linked fit groups
data.future_input_use: Generator diagnostic only; never causal model feature

decoder.integrate: deltaA=-delta t0,deltaB=+delta t1 from frozen fit lookup only
decoder.consistency_check: A-B=current spread on known anchors; invalid block retained as decoder inconsistency
decoder.interior_circularity: Translated-reference invariance on interior-to-interior decoder edges is imposed by target-difference fitting, not generator confirmation even on fresh components.
decoder.physical_identification: Unavailable without independent input-only displacement decoder or independent supplied quotes

primary_observation.stratum: Outside rows with strictly positive winner; absent from interior decoder vote supervision
primary_observation.prediction_selection: Next input-defined extremum regardless of realized target branch

break_known_block_on: a6 endpoint with unchanged code and unidentified displacement
unknown_policy.new_block_gauge: May reanchor separately; no continuity/horizon crosses unknown break

swing_algorithm.initial_direction: Unknown until excursionD from anchor; origins censored until first subsequent reversal confirmation
swing_algorithm.up_to_down: Track earliest running maxP; emit peak e when P-M>=2 at confirmation c
swing_algorithm.down_to_up: Track earliest running minQ; emit trough e when M-Q>=2 at confirmation c
swing_algorithm.next_mark: Earliest emitted extremum e>origin with confirmation c<=64 endpoint events after origin
swing_algorithm.prediction: B_origin+floor(M_e-B_origin+0.5);fixed half-up nearest lattice relative to origin bid, common-translation invariant

controls: Current midpoint rounded relative to origin bid under same half-up rule
Midpoint after first nonzero midpoint move rounded relative to origin bid,no target sign
Next4 mapped endpoint-midpoint average rounded relative to origin bid as old local-horizon background control

continuation_criteria.substantive_rejection: At least3 high-confidence counterexamples on distinct fresh components or accuracy/control failure

required_outputs: raw/reference/effective episode counts with named weights
reference changepoints versus extremum e and confirmation c
cheap_exclusions: Approximately30 effective episodes does not mean30 raw changes
Common future mark for both targets already fails outside algebra t0+t1+s_current=0
Static absolute price potential of current code contradicted by nonzero closed-code displacement
Endpoint equivalence cannot label unknown moves
Quote-quiet target constancy alone cannot identify generator horizon
Reject fixed next-swing mark without retuning threshold/horizon/rounding/branch
Winning-mark success does not repair rejected losing-offset laws

resources.estimate_status: Unmeasured; actor preserves incomplete counts on cap

promotion_authority: Independent critic/controller only; pass permits independent reproduction/input-decoder search, no model/auxiliary/inference fit or packaging automatically.
